title: A whole new look
items: A new dock with a big Play in the middle. The arrow inside Play picks what to play.
Your Library in one view, and Discover with a preview next to the list.
Continue right where you left off: your last world or server.
A crash helper that says what went wrong and fixes it with one button.
Five Wrapped, skin history, screenshot sharing and a new Privacy tab.
Just as light on your PC as 0.3.5.
